title: Canonical concept note frontmatter
description: The canonical layer. One note per concept, rewritten in place, never appended to. Session chatter goes to the journal instead, so notes stay readable months later instead of turning into a running log.

sections.description: Headings actually present in the body. Validation requires all six required sections from note_doctrine: definition, why-needed, mechanism, boundaries-and-misconceptions, relation-to-neighbours, worked-example-pointer.

links.description: concept_id values wiki-linked in the body. Builds the concept map.

source_refs.description: Citations into registered material, e.g. Strang 6.1 p.288.

rewrite_count.description: How many times this note has been rewritten in place. Appends are not a thing.
